Subject: MSA + Order Form — Confidentiality & Publicity redlines

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the draft MSA and the order form. Legal at BrightWave reviewed and attached a marked-up MSA with a handful of asks focused on confidentiality and publicity that we want to flag early so they don't hold up signature. Key items: 

- We need a narrow carveout allowing us to disclose a limited set of performance KPIs to our board (confidential but shared under NDA).
- We proposed a 30-day embargo on press/announcements after our GA date; can you confirm Redwood would be comfortable with that?
- BrightWave requests a "logo sandbox" clause: permission to use Redwood logo in our private marketing portal for partners (not public web pages) with a brand review step.
- We redlined the reference-rights clause — BrightWave wants to allow quotes in case studies subject to prior review with a 5-business-day approval window.

I attached the redlines (BrightWave_MSA_redlines.docx) and a short note from our Product/PR lead describing the sandbox use case. Can you loop in Redwood Legal and Sales so we can get language that works for both sides? We'd like to get to a stable redline this week if possible — we have a board meeting third week of December and would like the contract signed before then.

Thanks,
Carolyn Reed

Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form — Confidentiality & Publicity redlines (proposed language)

Team — I reviewed BrightWave's redlines and propose the following compromise language we can send back. Kept it narrow and operational so Sales can move quickly. 

1) Confidentiality carveout — board disclosures
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Customer may disclose Confidential Information (i) to its board of directors and executive leadership solely for the purpose of evaluating its ongoing engagement with Supplier, provided that such recipients are informed of the confidential nature of the information and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those set forth herein."

2) Publicity and references
"Supplier may identify Customer as a customer and display Customer's name and logo on Supplier's website, in marketing materials, and in industry lists; provided Supplier shall not use Customer's logo or trademark in press releases or advertising without Customer's prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld and shall be provided or deemed approved within five (5) business days of receipt of a written request. For the avoidance of doubt, Customer may review and request redactions of any proposed quote or case study excerpt prior to publication."

3) Logo sandbox (partner portal usage)
"Customer may use Supplier's logo and name within Customer's partner portal or private marketing portal for the limited purpose of partner enablement and internal marketing, provided that (a) such use is not for public-facing websites or paid advertising, (b) Customer submits proposed assets to Supplier's brand-approval email (brand@redwood.example) prior to use, and (c) Supplier's approval shall be granted or denied within three (3) business days. Any public use requires separate written approval under the Publicity section above."

A few implementation notes: 
- The three-day sandbox approval window helps our ops team (design/marketing) to quickly pre-clear assets.
- We'll accept BrightWave's 30-day post-GA embargo but request mutuality: Redwood will refrain from public announcement until the earlier of (i) BrightWave's announced GA date plus 30 days or (ii) mutual written agreement.
- For quotes/case studies we'll include a 5-business-day review clause and "not unreasonably withheld" protection so BrightWave isn't blocked.

If you want, I can insert these as tracked changes into our MSA and return a single document. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
